_comment: Every entity-key family (<prefix>_<id>) and every column that stores one. The byte-for-byte snapshot contract between EXE and APK depends on both apps agreeing on this list, so it is written once here and vendored into both (APP docs/APK-V3.md §9.1). Edit here, then npm run generate. SQL placeholders: owner takes a module id; lookup takes an id and must end in WHERE id=?; wiki takes (nexus, nexus, name); index takes (nexus, nexus). Order matters: it is the [[wiki]] resolver order after note and the legacy prefixes, and file stays last.

families.wiki: SELECT id FROM note WHERE (? IS NULL OR nexus_ref=?) AND migrated_v3=0 AND title=? COLLATE NOCASE
